jobs.title: CBE Reporting Statistics Financial Analyst (4229)
jobs.description:
* Prepare analytical statistics and detailed reports pre\-responding to regulatory authorities’ inquiries according to the classification of the Central Bank.


* Prepare of all aggregate statistics


* Prepare periodic statistics reports to be submitted to stakeholders/Authorities on agreed deadline with high level of accuracy and validity


* Assist in responding to inquiries received from the Central Bank


* Prepare reports responds to observations received from regulatory authorities
